items.title: One living former PM made the same choice as Sussan Ley
items.description: The issue for the Liberal Party is not simply the toppling of a female leader. It's also about what happened to that leader while she was in the job.

items.title: Here's what we know about Angus Taylor's policies
items.description: The new Liberal leader has signalled he will pursue a stricter immigration policy and a return to "Australian values" in his first pitch to win back voters.

items.title: Once a safe Coalition seat, Farrer is buzzing with talk of change
items.description: Just minutes after deposed Liberal leader Sussan Ley announced her resignation, constituents in her electorate of Farrer began murmuring about change.

items.title: Courtney thought her doctor 'knew best'. Then she asked to see her medical records
items.description: Pathology from Courtney's seven surgeries with Dr Simon Gordon repeatedly showed no signs of endometriosis. The surgeries left her medically infertile.

items.title: There is something that doesn't make sense in the Nancy Guthrie case
items.description: What initially seemed like a high-profile kidnapping that might be resolved with a multi-million-dollar bank transfer has now morphed into something else.

items.title: One celebrity in the entertainment world got Epstein 'withdrawal'
items.description: Some of the celebrities mentioned maintained friendships with Epstein even after his 2008 conviction for soliciting underage sex.

items.title: 'I could cry': James narrowly misses gold in thrilling halfpipe final
items.description: Scotty James has fallen short of an elusive Olympic gold, instead claiming a second silver medal in the snowboard halfpipe.

items.title: Quick hits: Calls to investigate judging ignored, Aussies forced home
items.description: A petition to investigate the judging of the ice dance competition has been dismissed by the sport's governing body, as two injured Australians are forced home from the Games. Here are the quick hits from the Winter Olympics.

items.title: The heartache of 'almost' strikes again for Scotty James
items.description: Scotty James has sought what resides at the end of the Olympic rainbow his whole career. But for the third time, he's had to settle for the numbing pain of almost being an Olympic champion.

items.title: A well-intentioned grand display turned a prince into a frog
items.description: It was a new high, or low, in performative relationship management for a generation who believe a flipped screen and a full-face confession of "accountability" can solve any problem.

items.title: From Japan to Israel, elections are reshaping global politics
items.description: At a time when so much of the global conversation is about the rapid decline of democracy, it is striking what a huge impact elections are having on world events just now.

items.title: Chicken behaviour the recipe for understanding human social dynamics
items.description: While growing up, people didn't make much sense to Summer, but chickens always did. Now, Summer is using what they learnt to help other children with autism understand human interactions.

items.title: Australian craft brewers hop on 'clean and easy' Japanese lagers
items.description: As record numbers of Australians continue to visit Japan, Japanese brewers have come to dominate our domestic beer market.

items.title: What the experts say about a crack found in the Bridgewater Bridge
items.description: Right to Information documents revealed a "large crack" was found on one of the piers of the new Bridgewater Bridge, days before its official opening. Experts weigh in to help us better understand the significance.

items.title: 'Storm before the calm': Israeli president's visit divides community
items.description: Two months after the deadly Bondi Beach terrorist attack, Israeli President Isaac Herzog's visit was meant to comfort a grieving community. Instead, it ignited protests and deepened divisions.

items.title: Singles ditch dating apps as marriage rates decline in Indonesia
items.description: Marriage is still a life goal in Indonesia, but the number of marriages has plummeted over the past decade.

items.title: Torvill and Dean's Bolero produces ice dance perfection at Winter Olympics
items.description: Jayne Torvill and Christopher Dean were already hot favourites for a gold medal. But on the ice in Sarajevo, the British ice dancers provided a performance of perfect artistry that made Olympic history.

items.title: What Black Saturday taught Victoria about responding to fire
items.description: Seventeen years after Black Saturday, experts reflect on what was learnt from the disaster and how it informs Victoria's current bushfire response.

items.title: German chancellor eyes European nuclear shield in call for reset with US
items.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz reveals Berlin has begun confidential talks with France about a European nuclear deterrent, saying the region has to become stronger in order to reset its relationship with the United States.

items.title: Lengthy lesson preparation for NSW teachers a 'great cost' to wellbeing
items.description: Educators are not being given enough time during the week to manage the complex needs of students with disabilities, a NSW teacher and assistant principal says.

items.title: CFMEU report is like a Hollywood script and Victoria's premier is on repeat
items.description: Pressure is mounting on Premier Jacinta Allan, as she challenges claims that billions in taxpayer dollars were funnelled to criminals via the CFMEU under her watch.

items.title: How going with the herd makes cattle loading calmer
items.description: A retired truck driver has developed a wide, steel, cattle-loading ramp that allows animals to walk side by side, mimicking natural herd behaviour and reducing noise, agitation and the risk of injury during transport.

items.title: Diver tells of being 20m underwater when shadow of shark passed overhead
items.description: Phillip Ellis Wells was solo diving roughly 7 kilometres off the east coast of Tasmania when he noticed a shadow pass overhead.

items.title: Nine people killed in Canada mass shooting identified
items.description: Six children and two adults were killed in the shooting in the remote Canadian town of Tumbler Ridge on Tuesday.

items.title: US aircraft carrier redeployed from Caribbean as Iran tensions rise
items.description: The United States will send the USS Gerald R. Ford aircraft carrier to the Middle East amid escalating tensions with Iran, according to US media outlets.
